title: Ronin Skill frontmatter
description: Contract for the YAML frontmatter of every framework/skills/<domain>/<slug>/SKILL.md. Validated by `ronin validate` and CI.

name.description: Globally unique, kebab-case, domain-prefixed slug (e.g. web-ssrf, api-graphql). Legacy reference skills keep tools-*/tech-*/htb-* names as stable aliases.

description.description: The auto-load trigger line. Must pack concrete signals: service/version, vuln class, tool-output patterns, error strings, ports.

type.description: arsenal = tool selection; technique = a concrete chain; methodology = how-to-operate; checklist = ordered list; reference = payloads/tables.

stability.description: locked = curated core, change deliberately; learning = the open contribution surface.

modes.description: Which authorization envelopes this skill is valid in.

mitre.description: MITRE ATT&CK technique IDs, e.g. T1190.
